changeSet.neo4j:cypher: MATCH (keeper:term {nanoid: '7VskP3'}) MATCH (redundant:term) WHERE redundant.nanoid IN ['zBF35N'] CALL { WITH keeper, redundant OPTIONAL MATCH (redundant)-[oldRel:represents]->(c:concept) WITH keeper, c, oldRel WHERE c IS NOT NULL MERGE (keeper)-[newRel:represents]->(c) SET newRel += properties(oldRel) RETURN count(*) AS represents_count } CALL { WITH keeper, redundant OPTIONAL MATCH (vs:value_set)-[oldRel:has_term]->(redundant) WITH keeper, vs, oldRel WHERE vs IS NOT NULL MERGE (vs)-[newRel:has_term]->(keeper) SET newRel += properties(oldRel) RETURN count(*) AS has_term_count } CALL { WITH keeper, redundant OPTIONAL MATCH (redundant)-[oldRel:has_tag]->(tag:tag) WITH keeper, tag, oldRel WHERE tag IS NOT NULL MERGE (keeper)-[newRel:has_tag]->(tag) SET newRel += properties(oldRel) RETURN count(*) AS has_tag_count } CALL { WITH keeper, redundant OPTIONAL MATCH (redundant)-[oldRel:specifies_value_set]->(specifiedVs:value_set) WITH keeper, specifiedVs, oldRel WHERE specifiedVs IS NOT NULL MERGE (keeper)-[newRel:specifies_value_set]->(specifiedVs) SET newRel += properties(oldRel) RETURN count(*) AS specifies_value_set_count } DETACH DELETE redundant
